name: Build two skills from one repo's conventions by selection
description: SPEC-2026-10-16-convention-skills AC-21. Uses the three pending convention candidates the seed adds to acme/payments-api (needs migration 0029). Accept all three, tick two and create a project-scoped skill: those two move to 'Used in skills' without any status change. Then tick the remaining one and create a global skill. The skill content scan runs without a model key in the hermetic stack (scan_status 'error' — the skill is still created), so the flow asserts only the page state. Creates two skills.
